AgentRunTotals.description:
A run's figures: geomind's ``total`` when the log has it, else the sum over
its agent sessions, each LLM call once.
AgentRunTotals.title: AgentRunTotals

AgentSession.description:
One agent session of a run, with its context against its own model's window.

``context_used`` is the session's current context: geomind's last reported
``used``, else the input of its latest LLM call. ``context_peak`` is the largest
it has been. ``context_left`` is geomind's ``remaining``, else the window minus
the context used, never below zero; ``None`` when either is unknown.
``cached_tokens`` is part of ``input_tokens``, ``None`` when no call reported it.
``instance`` names one of parallel instances of a role ("Geoscientist II"), else
``None`` (IMP-025).
AgentSession.title: AgentSession

AgentStudyRecord.description: What an agent stored for a study it ran, as stored in its ``study/<name>`` artifact.
AgentStudyRecord.title: AgentStudyRecord

AgentToolCall.description: One tool call of an agent session: its name, outcome and time, no contents.
AgentToolCall.title: AgentToolCall

AgentUsage.description: The sessions of one agent path added up; ``sessions`` counts them.
AgentUsage.title: AgentUsage

CallUsage.description: Tokens and cost, as geomind counts them; ``input_tokens`` holds the cached.
CallUsage.title: CallUsage

McpCheckStep.description: One step of a check: ``ok``, ``failed`` with a reason, or ``skipped``.
McpCheckStep.title: McpCheckStep

McpServer.description:
An MCP server as anyone may see it: the secret is only ``has_secret``.

``steps``, ``server_info`` and ``elapsed_ms`` come with the answer of a check
(``POST`` create and ``/check``) and are ``None`` everywhere else.
McpServer.title: McpServer

McpServerInfo.description: What the server said of itself in ``initialize``; ``None`` when not known.
McpServerInfo.title: McpServerInfo

Run.description:
A run of the assistant, as the runs page and the chat show it.

``sessions``, ``agents`` and ``total`` are geomind's figures from the root run's
last ``run.finished``. Only ``GET /assistant/runs/{id}`` reads them; every other
answer that holds a run, and a run that is still going or that geomind ended
without them, has ``None``.
Run.title: Run

RunAgents.description: The agent sessions of a run so far, in the order they started.
RunAgents.title: RunAgents

RunAnswer.description: The user's answer to the request a waiting run shows.
RunAnswer.title: RunAnswer

RunCall.description: One tool call of a run with its full stored output (the stream keeps a summary).
RunCall.title: RunCall

SessionContext.description: The context of one session: the largest and the last input of its own calls.
SessionContext.title: SessionContext

SessionUsage.description: What one agent session (one geomind run) spent on its own model calls.
SessionUsage.title: SessionUsage

Suggestion.description: A next step the user may click; ``message`` is sent as their next message.
Suggestion.title: Suggestion

TotalUsage.description: What the whole run tree spent, each model call counted once.
TotalUsage.title: TotalUsage
